text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the salads either lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and the venison chili was described as bland. There were also complaints about the limited menu range and the absence of cups for water, which affected the overall value and service experience. These concerns contributed to a low average rating of 1.75 across four reviews. Addressing food preparation and expanding menu choices could improve visitor satisfaction.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days indicate several issues with the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Multiple comments mention that salads and main dishes lack flavor or have awkward combinations, and some find the menu limited. One review highlights concerns about pricing and the absence of cups for water. There is also a note about service and wait times, though these were less frequently mentioned. Overall, the average rating is low, suggesting improvements are needed in food quality and value.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several reviewers noted limited menu options and poor food quality, describing some dishes as bland or poorly prepared. Wait times and service problems were also mentioned, including long lines and kitchen delays that prevented timely ordering. Some visitors felt the food was overpriced given the portion sizes and quality. Attention to improving the menu variety, food preparation, and service efficiency would address the main concerns raised.
